story_title: NVIDIA Unveils Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard to Cut Agentic AI Costs
why_this_story: NVIDIA is shifting focus from monolithic models to smart multi-model routing, offering up to a 66% cost reduction for running autonomous AI agents.

story_sentence: Everyone thinks agentic AI requires running expensive frontier models constantly, but NVIDIA's new routing architecture cuts costs to nearly one-third by dynamically delegating tasks.

caption:
NVIDIA just took aim at the biggest barrier to enterprise AI agents: operating costs. 

Instead of sending every request to massive frontier models, NVIDIA's new Nemotron 3.5 Lightning (30B MoE) and NeMo Switchyard open-source router dynamically assign tasks. 

In benchmarks with LangChain, intelligent routing achieved 74% lower costs by sending only 7% of calls to expensive frontier models—while preserving accuracy. 

Are you building single-model systems or routed systems of models? Let us know below.
